svg.title: Example: Cross-Team Retro
svg.desc: Worked example for a fictional team. A3 landscape cross-team retrospective: shared objectives and results, went well, cross-team problems, ideas, problem solving for the top problem, and follow-through.
svg.text: Reflect across teams at the end of a period: what worked, what didn't, and one system problem to fix together.
Coordinate Teams · Inspect & Adapt (SAFe) · Joint Retrospective · Fix the System
What We Set Out to Do
BRING THE SHARED OBJECTIVES AND THE DATA
Where did teams help each other?
Where did work wait between teams?
What would make next period smoother?
Improvements added to the next cross-team plan
Teams' own retros have the same themes?
Progress checked at the cross-team sync
“What got in the way between teams, not within them?”
“What one change would help every team next period?”
Coordinate Teams · Shared Outcomes · Manage Dependencies

g.text: Reorder landed; substitutes slipped an iteration

Nobody sees who needs what, and when
dependencies are agreed late, team to team

Contract tests for the Stock API
